facts.fact: The ministry's ICT Sector Strategic Plan lists, among the initiatives that improved local hosting, the introduction of the TransAfrica Communications (TrAC) data center in Rwanda; the document gives no opening date, so as_of is its published date 2025-01-01.
The plan states that Liquid Telecom launched a new data center in Rwanda, listed among the local hosting improvements; no date is given, so as_of is the document's published date 2025-01-01.
The plan states that MTN launched a new data center in Rwanda, listed among the local hosting improvements; no date is given, so as_of is the document's published date 2025-01-01.

The plan states that Business Services Company (BSC) launched a new data center in Rwanda, listed among the local hosting improvements; no date is given, so as_of is the document's published date 2025-01-01.

note: Plan states no tier ratings, no cloud region, and no absence; hosting localisation 14.9% of 4,660 websites and applications, data center and cloud directives issued 2023 and a 50% hosting price cut at the NDC are context, not facts.
